F _ Q _ S _ E _ Z _ F E Q _ S

options.text: E Z F Q S Q
E Z F Q S Z
Z Q F Q S Z
E Z E F S Z

questions.solution:
Given: F _ Q _ S _ E _ Z _ F E Q _ S

1. E Z F Q S Q → F **E** Q **Z** S - **F** E **Q** Z **S -** F E Q **Q** S

2. E Z F Q S Z → F E Q Z S - F E Q Z S - F E Q **Z** S

3. Z Q F Q S Z → F **Z** Q **Q** S - F E Q Z S - F E Q **Z** S

4. E Z E F S Z → F E Q Z S - **E** E **F** Z S - F E Q **Z** S

 
• Option (2) is follow the cycle of **"FEQZS"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"E Z F Q S Z".**
